scope: Direct Xrm calls on a rendered source-bound choice PCF sibling; each case begins with a standard-control reset. Exact typed before/after readbacks and errors; no field/control IDs disclosed.
limits: Only the source-bound PCF and standard pair in the two unsaved draft rounds is demonstrated.
Each reset contains one source option and an empty-text NaN option; source metadata has three options.
PCF remove-first and clear yielded empty arrays; do not substitute behavior from the standard caller.
Invalid removal cases were not preceded by inserting matching malformed values.
